queue.title: Adaptive breadth value-of-computation gate
queue.hypothesis: The supported width-2 benefit can be retained with less than 2x compute by spawning the second epistemic swarm only when the first swarm exhibits low proposal diversity or ambiguous top proposal values.
queue.design: Generate and score the baseline five-designer proposal set first. Observable gate features: number of unique concrete proposals, normalized margin between top two expected-gain scores, score dispersion, posterior entropy, and edge uncertainty. Compare simple preregistered gates and select on training worlds; freeze the simplest non-dominated gate and prospectively compare against always-width1 and always-width2 under identical intervention budgets and RNG-isolated observations.
queue.primary_metric: Pareto performance over edge error and inference compute

established_findings: Unconditional two-step search does not improve the primary metric after RNG isolation and costs roughly 9x compute.
Initial-state and local-margin depth gates failed to justify deeper search.
Uniform width-2 proposal breadth improves edge recovery over width-1 across combined n=72 matched worlds, with bootstrap CI excluding zero, at roughly 2x compute.

The width-2 gain is a portfolio effect: extra-only proposals supply about 45% of selected actions and useful contributions are distributed across FALSIFY, INFOGAIN, CHEAPEST and WEAKTIE. No simple role-pruning rule improves reliably on the full portfolio; RIVAL is behaviorally redundant in the observed prospective block.
dynamic_enqueue_rules: Every completed experiment must generate at least one next candidate unless a stronger queued candidate already tests the same uncertainty.
Falsification never empties the queue; it narrows or redirects it.
Do not enqueue equivalent retries without a changed causal hypothesis, state representation, reward, search depth, world model, or evaluation design.
Promote surprising anomalies and control victories into diagnostic experiments.
Maintain matched resource budgets and preserve all negative results.
